interpretation.fixed: The extra motion suite-load failure was CRLF checkout bytes versus its pinned LF scene. The extra Phase 8 test failure was the redundant root NAS-manifest attribute rule; main's nested manifest rule preserves the same raw JSON bytes without changing the Phase 8 fingerprint. Both now pass in the 43-test focused run.
